title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Field Service Rate Card: Labor and Trip Charges
content:
Rates that apply to technician service under Warranty Coverage when the visit is billable: the hourly labor rate and billable-hour rules for service outside the labor or workmanship term, and the two trip charges.

## Labor rates

| Plan | Hourly labor rate (USD) | Minimum billable labor per visit (hours) | Billing increment beyond the minimum (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 119.00 | 1.0 | 0.5 |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | 119.00 | 1.0 | 0.5 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | 109.00 | 1.0 | 0.5 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | 99.00 | 1.0 | 0.5 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | 89.00 | 1.0 | 0.5 |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | 89.00 | 1.0 | 0.5 |

- The hourly labor rate applies to service outside the labor or workmanship term.
- The minimum is the least billable labor for one visit outside the labor term.
- Billable labor beyond the minimum is rounded up to the billing increment.

## Trip charges

| Plan | Trip charge, visit outside the labor term (USD) | Trip charge, no covered defect found (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 125.00 | 125.00 |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | 125.00 | 125.00 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | 99.00 | 99.00 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | 89.00 | 89.00 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | 75.00 | 0.00 (waived) |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | 75.00 | 0.00 (waived) |

The no-defect trip charge is the charge when the technician finds no covered defect, and it is charged even inside the labor term; 0.00 marks a plan where it is waived.

## Reading the card

- The two lifetime plans with lifetime labor, the Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty and the Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty, waive the no-defect trip charge.
- In the other four plans the no-defect trip charge equals the out-of-term trip charge.
